summary: Frontend testing of NEW OTP verification authentication flow. All tested features working correctly. Login with existing accounts works, register form displays correctly with all fields, toggle between login/register modes works, and error handling prevents app crashes during rate-limited registration attempts.
critical_code_review_comments: LoginPage.jsx implements complete OTP flow with proper step states (form, verify, success)
OTP input component (OtpInput) correctly handles 6-digit input with auto-focus and paste support
AuthContext.js properly implements verifyOtp and resendVerification functions using Supabase Auth
Error handling catches rate limit (429) and parsing errors gracefully - app doesn't crash
context_for_next_testing_agent: OTP authentication flow implemented and code-verified. Login/register forms work correctly. OTP verification UI (6-digit input, verify button, resend button, back link) is properly implemented in code with correct data-testid attributes. Cannot test actual OTP email delivery due to Supabase rate limits (429) during testing - this is expected per the test request notes.

login_page_loads.details: Login page at /login loads correctly with BTP Facture branding, email/password inputs, and submit button

login_super_admin.details: Login with rafik.remila@gmail.com / Zeralda@0676 works - redirects to dashboard with 'Connexion réussie !' toast

login_admin.details: Login with admin@btpfacture.com / Admin123! works - redirects to dashboard

register_form_display.details: Register form at /login?mode=register shows all required fields: Nom complet, Téléphone, Nom de l'entreprise, Adresse, Email, Mot de passe

toggle_login_register.details: Toggle via 'Créer un compte' and 'Déjà un compte ? Se connecter' links works correctly

form_validation.details: HTML5 validation enforces required email and minLength=6 for password, 'Minimum 6 caractères' hint displayed

error_handling.details: Rate limit (429) error during registration shows toast error and doesn't crash the app - form remains usable

otp_ui_code_review.details: OTP verification UI components exist in LoginPage.jsx with correct data-testid attributes: otp-input-group, verify-otp-btn, resend-code-btn, otp-digit-0 through otp-digit-5

otp_input_behavior.details: OtpInput component handles: 6-digit input, auto-focus to next field, backspace navigation, paste support (via code review)

dashboard_after_login.details: Dashboard loads correctly showing Chiffre d'affaires, Factures impayées, Devis en attente, Clients, sidebar menu

mocked_apis_list: OTP email delivery - depends on Supabase email service (rate limited during testing)

testing_limitations.otp_verification_step: Cannot test actual OTP verification UI in browser due to Supabase 429 rate limits preventing signup completion. OTP UI verified via code review - all elements with correct data-testid attributes exist.
testing_limitations.supabase_rate_limits: Supabase email sending hits 429 rate limits during registration attempts - this is expected per test request notes
